title: On a spectral space every sheaf of sets is a directed colimit of subsheaves of finite products of pushed-forward finite constant sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of sets on $X$. For a closed subset $W\subseteq X$ with inclusion $i_W:W\to X$ and a set $S$ let $\underline S_W$ be the sheaf of locally constant maps to $S$ on $W$ ($V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq W$ open, with restriction of maps) and $(i_W)_*\underline S_W$ its direct image, $V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\cap W\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq X$ open. Then there are a directed set $\Lambda$ (nonempty, any two elements have a common upper bound), a system of sheaves of sets $(\mathcal F_\lambda,\varphi_{\mu\lambda}:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F_\mu)_{\lambda\le\mu}$ on $X$ over $\Lambda$ ($\varphi_{\lambda\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{\nu\mu}\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=\varphi_{\nu\lambda}$) and morphisms $c_\lambda:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F$ with $c_\mu\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=c_\lambda$ such that $(\mathcal F,(c_\lambda)_\lambda)$ is a colimit of the system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and such that for every $\lambda$ there are $n\ge0$, constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] closed subsets $Z_1,\dots,Z_n\subseteq X$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n$ and a morphism $\mathcal F_\lambda\to\prod_{k=1}^n(i_{Z_k})_*\underline{S_k}_{Z_k}$ (product computed sectionwise) which is injective on sections over every open of $X$.
